thread:
Maya: vendor Nightshade confirmed test window 2026-09-14 -> 2026-09-16. Need owners for RBAC, KMS scoping for evidence, audit snapshot, remediation tracker, and retest slots. Who can take?

Devon: I can own RBAC. Staging + preprod only. I will create ephemeral roles with permission boundaries and 5h TTL. No prod privileges.

Asha: I'll own audit/KMS. Plan: CloudTrail export at start/end, include STS:AssumeRole, IAM API events, and increase retention for this engagement to 120d. Will create snapshot bucket with SSE-KMS.

Oliver: I'll run the remediation board and tentatively reserve retest dates 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-05. Will add labels pt-sev1/2/3 and a column awaiting-retest.

Devon: IAM PR sketch (will open):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name nightshade-assessor-staging \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://assume-trust.json
# attach inline policy: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on pen-test-ingest prefix
# attach kms:Decrypt scoped to alias/nightshade-evidence
# attach permission boundary limiting write scope
```

Maya: KMS alias we should use: alias/nightshade-evidence. Do NOT create cross-account grants. Prefer vendor-side encryption + presigned upload for evidence ingestion.

Asha: Snapshot bucket: s3://redwood-audit/nightshade/ with bucket policy restricting to ephemeral role + audit group. Will also add manifest template for chain-of-custody.

Security Oncall: escalation: if Nightshade reports exploitable SEV1, open #incident-pt-nightshade and page oncall. Target ack <= 15m.

Oliver: retest criteria draft: fix merged + deployed to staging, PR linked in ticket, smoke/regression passed, artifacts uploaded to S3 with manifest, triage owner sign-off. I'll post checklist on the board.

Devon: prefer presigned PUT for vendor uploads. Example: `s3.getSignedUrlPromise('putObject', { Bucket, Key, Expires: 3600 })` and vendor encrypts client-side.

Asha: manifest example I'll use:
```
{
  "uploader": "Nightshade",
  "object_key": "pen-test-ingest/20260914/session-007.enc",
  "kms_key_alias": "alias/nightshade-evidence",
  "uploaded_at": "2026-09-14T13:04:00Z",
  "sha256": "..."
}
```

Legal: NDA/DPA check: need explicit KMS constraint and retention clause. Please route the vendor agreement; can do expedited review if owners add clauses now.

ci-bot: PR #821 opened (iam/nightshade-ephemeral + bucket policy). CI: tests passed :white_check_mark:

Maya: owners recap: RBAC=Devon, KMS/audit=Asha, Remediation/Retest=Oliver, Incident=Security Oncall, Legal=Legal. Action items: Devon open PR + docs, Asha upload runbook, Oliver create board and post retest criteria, Legal expedite NDA.

Devon: will tag @Maya on PR and enforce MFA in trust policy. TTL enforcement via lambda scheduled job.

Asha: runbook upload target EOD; will include CloudTrail export commands, Athena query snippets for STS/IAM anomalies, and archive workflow t+30d.

Maya: no SSH, no prod access, audited uploads only. Once PRs + runbooks are green I'll do the vendor handshake and publish assessor onboarding doc. Thanks everyone :rocket:
